newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone threatens shipping east of Australia - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone threatens shipping east of Australia - WSC.

text.p: Tropical cyclone Justin will become a significant risk to shipping in the Coral Sea to the east of Cairns, Australia, during this weekend, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Friday.
Top winds are currently 55 mph but they may increase to 85-90 mph during the next 48-72 hours.

The system is currently about 400 miles east of Cairns and moving west, WSC said. It should move westward for about 24 hours before stalling, then begin to drift back towards the east. This track will keep it well east of the Australia coast during the weekend.
